scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Kotlin client conforming to com.google.firebase:firebase-crashlytics via the Pyric WebSocket bridge and CrashlyticsBroker. Covers per-app FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance and Firebase.crashlytics KTX extensions, primitive and nullable setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled overrides, FIFO log breadcrumbs, setUserId and KeyValueBuilder custom keys, recordException stack and chained-cause serialization with per-report custom keys, checkForUnsentReports / sendUnsentReports / deleteUnsentReports queues, flush and getState inspection, and RS256 App Check token attachment.
